decision: B-23 (主控裁决 2026-10-01): 公版老书的出版/重印说明不是故事简介，简介命中下列任一句式时整段简介不参与关键词匹配；标题照常匹配。只修这一类。
effect: Classifier-only. A description that matches any pattern below contributes no description-field keyword hits for that novel. Titles are matched exactly as before. Upstream-mapped (source label) tags and manual tags are never touched by this list; it is read only by the deterministic text classifier.
matching: Both the description and each phrase are normalised the same way before comparison: Unicode NFKC, lower-cased, typographic quotes and dashes folded to ASCII, runs of whitespace collapsed to one space, trimmed. position=anywhere: the phrase occurs anywhere in the description. position=start: the normalised description begins with the phrase.
verification: UNVERIFIED_AGAINST_PRODUCTION_DATA. The phrases are well-known public-domain-reprint publisher blurbs recalled from public listings; they were not fetched or checked online in this session and have not yet been counted against production descriptions. The read-only impact report (tagging-backfill.ts --impact-report) prints a per-pattern hit count; review it before any apply and drop any pattern that matches real story blurbs.
excluded_by_decision: Alpha used figuratively (German 'Alpha-Raubtier' style): not changed. keyword-eligibility-v2 Owner Final (2026-08-17) adds no rule for single-sample cases and blanket per-locale suppression falsely removed ~40% of correct tags.
French 'chef' (boss) vs English 'chef': not changed. keyword-eligibility-v2 states chef carries no rule at all.

patterns.phrase: this work has been selected by scholars as being culturally important
patterns.source: Public-domain reprint blurb (Kessinger/BiblioLife/Dodo-style listings); named in the B-23 brief
patterns.reason: Opening sentence of a standard reprint disclaimer; the 'description' is publisher front matter, not a synopsis.

patterns.phrase: is part of the knowledge base of civilization as we know it
patterns.source: Same disclaimer as bp-001 (its second half)
patterns.reason: Catches listings where only the tail of the disclaimer survives truncation.

patterns.phrase: this is a reproduction of a book published before 1923
patterns.source: Nabu Press/BiblioLife-style on-demand reprint blurb; named in the B-23 brief
patterns.reason: Describes the edition, not the story.

patterns.phrase: this book was originally published prior to 1923
patterns.source: Kessinger-style reprint blurb; named in the B-23 brief
patterns.reason: Describes the edition, not the story.

patterns.phrase: reprint of the original, first published in
patterns.source: Hansebooks/Outlook-style reprint listings; named in the B-23 brief
patterns.reason: Whole description is usually just this one line.

patterns.phrase: this scarce antiquarian book is a facsimile reprint
patterns.source: Facsimile-reprint publisher blurb; named in the B-23 brief
patterns.reason: Describes the edition, not the story.

patterns.phrase: we have recreated this book from the original
patterns.source: Digital-recreation reprint blurb; named in the B-23 brief
patterns.reason: Describes the edition, not the story.

patterns.source: Forgotten Books-style blurb ('Excerpt from <Title> ...'); named in the B-23 brief
patterns.reason: Short phrase, so it only counts at the very start of the description; in the middle of a real synopsis 'excerpt from' is ordinary prose.

patterns.phrase: unlike some other reproductions of classic texts
patterns.source: Quality-claim paragraph in classic-text reprint blurbs; named in the B-23 brief
patterns.reason: Publisher marketing about the scan quality, not the story.

patterns.phrase: this is a pre-1923 historical reproduction that was curated for quality
patterns.source: Wentworth Press/Creative Media Partners-style reprint blurb
patterns.reason: Describes the edition, not the story.

patterns.phrase: this book is a reproduction of an important historical work
patterns.reason: Describes the edition, not the story.

patterns.phrase: forgotten books publishes hundreds of thousands of rare and classic books
patterns.reason: Publisher boilerplate appended to the excerpt.

patterns.phrase: may have occasional imperfections such as missing or blurred pages
patterns.reason: Describes scan quality, not the story.

patterns.phrase: as part of our continuing commitment to the preservation of printed works worldwide
patterns.reason: Publisher boilerplate, never part of a synopsis.

patterns.phrase: this work is in the public domain in the united states of america
